summary: Truncates a string at its first dot character (ASCII 46): scans for the dot, replaces it with a NUL terminator, and returns 1. Returns 0 when the string is empty or contains no dot. Called by StringSearchInLinkedList to normalize a key before comparison.

operations.description: Calls strlen on the input string to determine whether it is empty
Returns 0 immediately when the string is empty
Scans forward through the string until a dot character (ASCII 46) is found or the end of the string is reached
Returns 0 when the end of the string is reached without finding a dot
Overwrites the found dot with a NUL terminator, truncating the string at that position
Returns 1 to signal the string was truncated at its first dot
